title: Regular Polygon Explorer Quiz
description: An interactive quiz MicroSim where students test their knowledge of polygon names by creating shapes matching given prompts.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mathematics
Geometry
Polygons
Assessment
learningObjectives: Recall the names of regular polygons such as triangle, square, pentagon, and hexagon from their side counts
Match a prompted polygon name to the correct number of sides by constructing the shape
Identify a regular polygon from its rendered shape without counting each side individually
Evaluate your own polygon-naming accuracy using the quiz's immediate feedback
